reviewItems.name: Hosted graph benchmark trend
acceptanceCriteria: At least 5 unique hosted benchmark runs have been reviewed.
Latest hosted recall latency is below the configured threshold.
Average hosted recall latency is below the configured threshold.
Reviewer records whether the current threshold is acceptable for alpha launch.

review.decision: Accept hosted graph recall benchmark trend for alpha launch readiness.
review.notes: Manual Live Production Benchmark run 33231544217 passed on main commit 48fac89. Artifact size is 956 bytes after capping historical downloads and uploading only current JSONL plus summary. Latest recall latency 2895.96ms and average recall latency 1221.60ms are below the 12000ms threshold; latest import latency regressed to 125726.34ms and should remain monitored outside the recall gate.

reviewItems.notes: Hosted benchmark trend evidence is accepted for alpha recall readiness; semantic trace review and rerank threshold review remain separate pending RAG launch gates.

reviewItems.name: Semantic RAG trace review
acceptanceCriteria: Live smoke includes semantic recall from Workers AI and Vectorize.
Production traces have been sampled for semantic recall latency and result quality.
Reviewer records whether stale-index and repair warning thresholds are acceptable.
Reviewer records any launch-blocking semantic provider errors.
reviewItems.notes: Live smoke proves semantic provider contribution, but broader trace review and threshold tuning are still pending.

reviewItems.name: Rerank threshold review
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic reranking remains within recall-quality thresholds.
Optional Workers AI reranker latency and cost budget have been reviewed if enabled.
Reviewer records whether OPENMEMORY_RERANK_MODEL should remain disabled, optional, or recommended for hosted alpha.
Reviewer records any threshold changes needed before broad hosted launch.
reviewItems.notes: Rerank readiness is visible in /v1/readiness, but launch posture still needs a production evidence review.
